title: Green's first identity on R^n against a compactly supported C^1 function
statement: Let n in N. Let H : R^n -> R be of class C^2, let Psi : R^n -> R be of class C^1 with compact support, and let w : R^n -> R^n satisfy DPsi(z)[v] = <w(z), v> for all z, v in R^n (so w is the gradient of Psi). Then int_{R^n} DH(z)[w(z)] dz = - int_{R^n} Laplacian(H)(z) Psi(z) dz. Here DH(z)[v] = fderiv R H z v, Laplacian is Mathlib's Laplacian.laplacian, and the measure is Lebesgue measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (H Ψ : Rn n → ℝ) (w : Rn n → Rn n), ContDiff ℝ 2 H → ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ → HasCompactSupport Ψ → (∀ z v : Rn n, fderiv ℝ Ψ z v = inner ℝ (w z) v) → ∫ z, fderiv ℝ H z (w z) = -∫ z, Laplacian.laplacian H z * Ψ z
